correctness.rationale: The unitary Mellin transform converts H_a into a bounded bilateral weighted translation with modulus C_a/[cosh(pi s)cosh(pi(s-a))]^(1/2). Multipliers of H_a^n have strictly convex negative logs symmetric about n a/2, yielding the stated exact cosh-product power norms. Summed log cosh values give log norm = -(pi|a|/4)n²+n log(2C_a)+O_a(1). Neumann sum gives log resolvent <= L²/(pi|a|)+O(L), while short-support Mellin inputs make all terms orthogonal and produce the matching phase-uniform lower bound. The modulus spectrum [0,norm] has no eigenvalues, and every positive power remains noncompact. Independent Gamma and log-power calculations for 12 (a,n) samples corroborate formulas. No result is claimed at a=0.
